A great tower collapses in a cascade of stone and dust behind the dragon, defenders tumbling with the rubble.
A ballista-bolt the size of a tree trunk punches through the dragon's wing-membrane in a spray of dark blood.
A wizard on the rampart hurls a lance of crackling blue counter-fire upward, splitting the descending column of flame.
A second dragon, scales black as coal, wheels into view from the east, shrieking a challenge across the smoke.
A volley of flaming arrows arcs up from the courtyard in a burning curtain, streaming past the dragon's belly.
A hero leaps from the gatehouse wall, sword raised and screaming, catching the firelight on polished steel as he falls.
The powder-store beneath the east bastion detonates, throwing a mushroom of orange fire and shattered stone into the air.
A cavalry charge breaks apart on the scorched field below, horses rearing and screaming, riders flung across the burning grass.
A magic shield flares white-hot under the dragon's fire, shattering outward in a burst of crackling arcane sparks.
A banner bearing the king's crest catches fire and plummets from the highest spire, trailing black smoke as it falls.
A wall breach floods suddenly with enemy soldiers, iron armor glinting as they pour through the gap in a roaring tide.
A second volley of ballista-bolts rises in formation, four shafts climbing together, one clipping the dragon's trailing hindleg.
The northern tower cracks at its base and folds slowly, spilling its stones across the courtyard in a grinding roar.
A war-elephant stampedes through the castle gate, burning and screaming, scattering defenders in every direction across the cobblestones.
A chain-bridge snaps under panicking soldiers, dropping a dozen armored men into the churning moat far below.
A pair of griffins, their riders ablaze, spiral down through the smoke and crash into the outer wall.
The great portcullis shears from its housing and slams down with a thunderous clang, trapping soldiers on both sides.
A river of molten lead pours from a collapsed battlement, cascading over the wall-face in a glowing silver sheet.
A hedge-knight on a pale horse drives his lance into a siege-engine, toppling it in a shriek of splintering timber.
The siege tower nearest the gate ignites all at once, men leaping from every window as it becomes a pillar of fire.
A wizard's summoned storm-wall rises to meet the chaos, lightning snapping sideways across the courtyard in blinding white arcs.
A massive catapult arm snaps under tension, whipping around and scything three soldiers off the rampart in an instant.
The moat-drawbridge collapses mid-crossing, plunging a column of armored soldiers into the deep cold water below.
An enemy war-horn sounds three long blasts and a fresh regiment crests the hill, shields locked and spears leveled.
A master-engineer lights a pre-laid fuse beneath the gatehouse, and the archway erupts upward in a thunderclap of stone and smoke.
